item.title: New TIL: two-state dark mode toggles.
item.description:
New TIL: two-state dark mode toggles.
I keep returning to @lea.verou.me’s argument: rather than making people think about `System`, a dark mode control should only switch away from whatever state looks “yuck”.
https://ciaranlyons.com/til/2026/09/07/two-state-dark-mode-toggles

item.title: TIL: Two-state dark mode toggles
item.description: A persistent theme toggle should switch away from “yuck,” not make people choose a system setting.
